سَائِرٌ [part. n. of 1, Going, &c. ―
-b2- Hence,] (assumed tropical:) A proverb [and a saying] current, or commonly known. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also, and ↓ سَارٌ , (S, M, K,) both are syn., (K,) signifying The rest, or remainder, of a thing: (M:) [and accord. to some,] the whole, or all, of a thing or of people. (S, TA.) [See the former word in art. سأر.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
